decision: Build in the existing folder Programming/medieval-risk-wheel as its own repo and deploy target
rationale: Owner created the folder; each game is a separate portfolio link
tradeoffs: Patterns from frontier-bounty are copied and adapted, not shared

decision: Single Vite package with lint-enforced layers core ← engine ← adapters/audio/config ← scene ← ui (ADR-0001)
rationale: One deployable with machine-checked boundaries; engine testable in Node

decision: Canvas 2D scene, pure wheel kinematics (velocity-continuous cubic deceleration to server sector) and pin/spring pointer with exact tick count (ADR-0002)
rationale: Physical feel while landing deterministically on the server outcome

decision: Native medieval material system, IM Fell English SC + EB Garamond tabular numerals, procedural astrolabe wheel, alchemist + raven characters; neon/purple-cyan/SaaS-card tropes banned (ADR-0003)
rationale: Owner's top priority: craft that does not read as generic AI UI

decision: 9-state trial machine with allow-list, requestId guard, retry-only mid-trial errors; per-rung wheels with multipliers floor2((1-edge)/P(reach k)) (ADR-0004)
rationale: Races unrepresentable; exact RTP upper bound for every claim strategy

decision: Server-authoritative TrialProvider; per-spin SHA-256(serverSeed:clientSeed:nonce:n) → sector + landing offset; idempotent requestIds (ADR-0005)
